GlobalLink 3.0 Help Guide

As of November 2016, GlobalLink will have a new appearance for our clients. Much
of the functionality remains the same, though the look of the site is very different.
This brief introduction will provide help, pointers and best practices for using
GlobalLink.

Please note that not all screens outlined in this overview are available as some
require specific access.

![GLLogo.png](https://eus-cdn.sway.static.microsoft/s/Xi8NQM2vMZjvksoA/images/gM-2kzSLmDHL1L?quality=513&allowAnimation=true)

The Basics

\*\*Presentation Note: Please click on any image to enlarge!

Left Hand Menu

Click the Question Mark icon to access the help tutorials from anywhere within the
GlobalLink site.

![image.png](https://eus-cdn.sway.static.microsoft/s/Xi8NQM2vMZjvksoA/images/W0L6wMcEQ5mHMy?quality=35&allowAnimation=true)

Click on the Gears icon to access user settings and preferences from anywhere within
the GlobalLink site.

![image.png](https://eus-cdn.sway.static.microsoft/s/Xi8NQM2vMZjvksoA/images/Xfy6iKZkjQ330m?quality=44&allowAnimation=true)

Click on the message icon to send messages to a Mohawk Global representative.
Please feel free to contact us with any questions or comments about the site.

![image.png](https://eus-cdn.sway.static.microsoft/s/Xi8NQM2vMZjvksoA/images/YezeVWchvNXtlT?quality=41&allowAnimation=true)

Top Menu Bar

Click on the Home icon to return to the GlobalLink Welcome Page and menu from
anywhere within the site.

![image.png](https://eus-cdn.sway.static.microsoft/s/Xi8NQM2vMZjvksoA/images/Fppecv8Z4JDgCU?quality=52&allowAnimation=true)

Click on the X icon to log out of GlobalLink.

![image.png](https://eus-cdn.sway.static.microsoft/s/Xi8NQM2vMZjvksoA/images/Nw8fMrsqvFQZkD?quality=39&allowAnimation=true)

Hover over this icon to see your username and company.

![image.png](https://eus-cdn.sway.static.microsoft/s/Xi8NQM2vMZjvksoA/images/Y18_yCF5MdOSJg?quality=52&allowAnimation=true)

Click on the Global Link logo at any time to return to the main menu.

![Capture_Logo.JPG](https://eus-cdn.sway.static.microsoft/s/Xi8NQM2vMZjvksoA/images/lChAmMhM_GA0nc?quality=344&allowAnimation=true)

Logging In

Although the log-in screen appearance has changed, the functionality has not. All
usernames and passwords remain the same as they did in the previous GlobalLink
version.

If a new user requires access, click ‘Request Login Credentials’ and enter information.
An email will be sent to the Mohawk Global Logistics support team.

We also added a ‘Need Assistance?’ link on the log-in page that can be used to send a
message to Mohawk Global support as needed.

Quick Track

![Capture_QuickTrack.JPG](https://eus-cdn.sway.static.microsoft/s/Xi8NQM2vMZjvksoA/images/k27qh5h1TuIigg?quality=516&allowAnimation=true)

Another new edition to our Log-in Screen is the Quick Track utility, available to
everyone, even without a Global Link account. MGL Reference Number, PO Number,
or Master Bill Number can be used to search basic information here – partial
numbers are also acceptable. The File No and BL Number columns in the results grid
are sortable.

Admin Page

If you have been chosen as the administrator for your company, there are various
options available to customize individual user accounts.

New User set-up

- Each client company will have the opportunity to set up a client administrator. This
administrator will have the ability to set up their users’ preferences as detailed
below. If this person leaves the company or the client admin must change, the
client must notify MGL and set up a new client administrator.

Setting User Preferences

- Client administrators can choose which user to set up preferences for under 'Set
Up Preferences'

Setting Shipment Details

- Use these to set which detail sections users will see on their Shipment Detail pages
as well as setting their reporting options

Shipment Details

Shipment Dashboard

- Click on Dashboard filters to open up a date filter for all of the charts displayed
- Each graph is ‘clickable’ – users can click any data point to open up a detailed view
of the shipments/invoices that make up that data point

Shipment View

- Universal Search

  - The Universal Search automatically shows the last 10 shipments by Estimated
    Time of Departure (ETD). The Universal Search form can be used to search for
    any shipment using the Container No, MGL #, or PO Number – partial numbers
    are also adequate.

- Shipment Tables

  - Each table shows types of shipments and can be sorted by any of the column
    headers
  - Available Tables:

    - Latest Shipments by ETD
    - Shipments in Next 7 Days
    - Late Shipments

Shipment Detail

- Displayed detail varies based on specific access set by client admins. Furthermore,
the detail displayed depends on the type of shipment - CHB, Air, or Ocean.
- Includes:

  - Shipment High Level Detail
  - Customs Data
  - Transportation Documentation
  - Related POs
  - Vessel Information

Further Shipment Detail:

- Location Matrix
- PO Details
- Invoice Details
- Container Details
- Shipment Notes

Brokerage Details

The newest major addition to our site is the Brokerage section which gives users the
power of visibility to Customs entry details. Users can now track, sort, and filter
multiple entries at a time or drill down for a more granular view of a single entry.

o Search

- The Search box can be used to search entries by Entry Number, PO Number, MGL
Reference Number, Container Number, Master Bill Number, House Bill Number, or
Part Number. Partial entries of any of these is also accepted.
- The main search screen automatically shows the latest entries by Estimated Time of
Arrival (ETA). The Universal Search form can be used to search for any shipment
using the Container No, MGL #, Master Bill Number, Part Number or PO Number –
partial numbers are also adequate.

- Each graph is ‘clickable’ – users can click any data point to open a detailed view
of the shipments/invoices that make up that point
- This dashboard is exportable to Excel and will also provide tabs of detailed data
about each graph

- Each tab contains information related to the entry, including a breakdown of the
commercial invoice, container, tracking, and PO details, PDFs of the invoice and any
other attached documents.
- Any notes attached to the entry by MGL coordinators will be displayed at the
bottom of the page

Utilities

We now offer the ability to view all Products in our products database. Here parts can
be viewed, added, or edited. A list of all products can be exported directly from this
page.

Click into any product to see or edit details:

As requirements are added, more data is required – for example, if a PGA
requirement is selected, then the PGA FDA or TTB tab will need to be completed.
Further requirements can be added by request.

Bookings

\*\*Please note that not all screens outlined in this overview are available as some
require specific access.\*\*

- The booking requests page is for bookings that do not yet have shipment numbers
assigned

- Viewing a specific booking allows the user to review booking data and then
Approve/Reject and add notes
- All notes will be sent into the internal Booking Request system for Mohawk
associates to access

Entry Review

\*\*Please note that not all screens outlined in this overview are available as some
require specific access.\*\*

- Entries appear in three separate categories: Requires Attention, Flagged or
Approved. All new entries begin in ‘Requires Attention’ until a client reviews them
and add notes. It can then move into ‘Flagged’ if it needs further review or to
‘Approved’ if the entry review is complete.
- Users can search for specific entries within each of the three categories or view a
range of entries within a specified time period.
- All notes are automatically sent to an MGL counterpart for review

PO Manager

\*\*Please note that not all screens outlined in this overview are available as some
require specific access.\*\*

PO Manager Capabilities and Features:

- PO Dashboard with graphs and trackers
- PO and ASN Search
- PO Editor
- PO-specific Reporting
- Data Utilities including:

  - Container Manifest upload
  - ASN Entry
  - Manual PO upload

Reporting

New Reporting capabilities have been added to Global Link 2.0. Users can now
create, schedule and save custom reports, as well as access a group of standard
reports for either Export to Excel or on-screen display.

Standard Reports

- All standard reports can be downloaded as an Excel file or displayed on-screen.
Prompts will appear when additional information is needed (e.g. Date Range)

Brokerage Reports

- Brokerage reporting has all entry related reports. It is set up the same way as
Standard Reports and has the same functionality.

Historic Reports

- Historic reporting should be used to retrieve data prior to January 1, 2017. It is set
up the same way as Standard Reports and has the same functionality.

Reporting Functionality

- A new report is created by selecting a variety of data points:

- As well as required columns:

- After all required data is selected, the user can Save the Report, which will prompt a
scheduling feature:

![Capture_Reporting3.jpg](https://sway.cloud.microsoft/Xi8NQM2vMZjvksoA)

Saved Reports

- A saved report will appear in the Saved Reports tab with criteria and scheduled
time listed:

![Capture_ReportingSaved.jpg  (Moderate)](https://sway.cloud.microsoft/Xi8NQM2vMZjvksoA)

- From here, the report can be displayed or exported just like a standard report, or it
contents or schedule can be edited through the Edit button
